purpose: The AEA entity's fuel registry. Every model it can run for free, classified by the two axes that actually matter for an always-on PERSONAL entity: (1) privacy = does the provider train on your prompts; (2) throughput = the binding free rate limit. Routing rule: private data -> ring0/ring1 (no-train) ONLY. Public data -> ring2 ok. Heartbeat -> ring0 (local). Escalate to ring1 for quality; frontier (Opus) is ignition only.

privacyTiers.local: Runs on Luis's own hardware. Nothing leaves the machine. Safe for anything.
privacyTiers.no-train: Hosted, but the provider's official policy says it does NOT train on your inputs/outputs. Safe for private data.
privacyTiers.trains-default: Hosted and trains on free-tier prompts BY DEFAULT. Opt-out toggle exists. Treat as PUBLIC-DATA-ONLY until opt-out is confirmed in-console.
privacyTiers.no-guarantee: No clear no-train commitment found. Non-sensitive data only.

rings.ring0_local_base: Ollama. Unlimited, private, free, offline. Carries the 24/7 heartbeat: embeddings, routing, classification, cheap reasoning. The entity's default brain.
rings.ring1_private_hosted: No-train free hosted. Quality/speed bursts on PRIVATE data the local box can't handle. Cloudflare, SambaNova, Cerebras, NVIDIA NIM, OVHcloud.
rings.ring2_public_hosted: High-throughput free hosted that trains on data. Public-only: scan news/stocks/markets/research. Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter, Groq.
rings.ring3_specialist: Reserve-for-value or fallback. Cohere rerank (best, tiny quota), Pollinations (keyless fallback), HF router (failover abstraction).

providers.bindingLimit: NONE. Bounded only by the machine. 32 models pulled.
